scientific_integrity: An analytical proof and standalone finite exact checks are supplied. The double-centering projector and same-exponent projection norms are credited to earlier work. No independent external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Unit-edge complete bipartite graphs, orthogonal edge-space Euclidean metric only; no counts of distinct contacts in all sizes or results for weighted graphs; historical priority provisional. Finite exact tests supplement but do not replace the all-parameter proof.
title: Exact Euclidean diameters and parity-rigid contacts of biclique cycle-space zonotopes
